Judicial Magistrate of First Class,
Parchur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
3.
The petitioner before this Court is an accused, who charged for the offences under Sections 273 and 188 of Indian Penal Code and Section 58 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
This Court in earlier batch of criminal petitions has already taken a decision that Tobacco products of which the accused is said to have been trading, do not fall on the food or food products.
4. The learned Public Prosecutor does not oppose the legal position.
5. This Court also holds that the offence under Section 277 and 188 of IPC and Section 58 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, are also not attracted.
Crl.P.Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27.08.2018 were finally disposed of and following the said judgment, this Court is of the opinion that the petition has to be allowed.
6. Hence, all further proceedings in C.C.No.85 of 2018 on the file of Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Parchur are quashed.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Parchur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.

SPR THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE D.V.S.S.SOMAYAJULU CRIMINAL PETITION No.7775 of 2019 Dated 19.12.2019.
